Package org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore

Class TrinoFilterToSQL

java.lang.Object
org.geotools.data.jdbc.FilterToSQL
org.locationtech.geomesa.trino.datastore.TrinoFilterToSQL
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.geotools.api.filter.expression.ExpressionVisitor, org.geotools.api.filter.FilterVisitor
public class TrinoFilterToSQL extends org.geotools.data.jdbc.FilterToSQL
Translates GeoTools filters to Trino SQL WHERE clauses of pure row-level ST_* function calls (plus temporal/attribute predicates). Geom column references are always wrapped in ST_GeomFromBinary(geom) and geometry literals in ST_GeometryFromText('<wkt>') — matches the shape recognized by the spatial_iceberg connector's SpatialConnectorMetadata.applyFilter.

Swapped operand forms are normalized column-first via the OGC complement (within(a, b) ⇔ contains(b, a)) so the connector's ST_*(ST_GeomFromBinary(col), literal) recognizer always matches.

      protected Object visitBinarySpatialOperator(org.geotools.api.filter.spatial.BinarySpatialOperator filter, org.geotools.api.filter.expression.PropertyName property, org.geotools.api.filter.expression.Literal literal, boolean swapped, Object extraData)
      Single translation point for every binary spatial operator. swapped means the geometry literal was expression1 (e.g. INTERSECTS(POLYGON, geom)) — irrelevant for symmetric operators, semantics-reversing for Within/Contains, which are normalized column-first via their OGC complement (within(a, b) ⇔ contains(b, a)).

      public Object visit(org.geotools.api.filter.spatial.BBOX filter, Object extraData)
      Translates a BBOX filter into ST_Intersects against the envelope rectangle — BBOX(geom, env) ⇔ INTERSECTS(geom, envelope-rectangle). The connector derives bbox/Z2 pruning from the call; the exact row-level test keeps the predicate correct against the float32-rounded stored bboxes.

    • writeLiteral

      protected void writeLiteral(Object literal) throws IOException
      Temporal literals must be TIMESTAMP-typed in the emitted SQL: the base class writes Date values as quoted strings, which Trino cannot compare to a timestamp-with-time-zone column. Covers BEFORE/AFTER, BETWEEN, and plain comparison operators on date attributes (DURING has its own visit).
      Overrides:
      writeLiteral in class org.geotools.data.jdbc.FilterToSQL
      Parameters:
      literal - the literal value to write
      Throws:
